finalText:
**Migration done.** I moved 36 `db.query` calls to `db.execute({ sql, params })` across 12 files.

All 12 pass `node --check`. Sample: [refund.js:9](packages/billing/src/repo/refund.js:9).

Two calls stay in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it.

I left `cache.query` alone. Different object, not part of this.

Next: `db.query` cannot be deleted from `lib/db.js` while vendor uses it. Your call on how to unblock that.
